question: What is the section 148 withholding rate on imports of goods falling in Part-I of the Twelfth Schedule for ATL and non-ATL importers?
I import finished goods to resell in my market, and they are in the third part of the 12th schedule list. How much income tax does customs take if I'm a filer?
We import medicines for our pharmacy chain. What income tax is charged at the import stage?
We assemble electric cars from imported kits. What income tax is charged when the kits come in?
What advance tax is collected on import of mobile phones under PCT 8517.1219?
answer: Rs. 70 to Rs. 11,500 for ATL; Rs. 140 to Rs. 23,000 for non-ATL

question: What is the section 148 rate for manufacturers covered by SRO 1125(I)/2011 under proviso 1(a)?
I bring in raw material for my own factory and it's on the second list of the 12th schedule. What's the tax at customs for a filer versus a non-filer?
My yearly salary is Rs 10 lakh. How much tax should my employer cut on the part above 6 lakh?
I earn about Rs 18 lakh a year from my job. How is the tax on my pay worked out?
answer: Rs. 6,000 + 11% of the amount exceeding Rs. 1,200,000

question: My pay package is around 35 lakh a year. Which slab am I in and what do I pay?
answer: Rs. 346,000 + 30% of the amount exceeding Rs. 3,200,000

question: I'm a senior manager and my salary is above one crore a year. Is there anything extra on top of the normal tax?
answer: Rs. 616,000 + 35% of amount exceeding Rs. 4,100,000, plus 9% surcharge

question: I make Rs 50,000 a month, 6 lakh a year in total. Should any tax be deducted from my pay?
answer: No, 0% where taxable income does not exceed Rs. 600,000

question: According to Circular 01 of 2025-26, what rate applies where taxable income exceeds Rs.600,000 but does not exceed Rs.1,200,000?
Under Division I of Part I of the First Schedule, what is the tax on taxable income exceeding Rs. 3,200,000 but not exceeding Rs. 4,100,000?
answer: Rs. 346,000 + 30% of the amount exceeding Rs. 3,200,000

question: I retired from a company and my pension is more than 1 crore a year. I'm 65. How is it taxed?
answer: 5% of the amount exceeding Rs. 10 million plus 10% surcharge

question: Under Circular 01 of 2025-26, which pension recipients are not chargeable to tax?
answer: Those older than 70, or whose pension is less than Rs. 10 million per annum

question: Under section 12(2A), how is pension from a former employer exceeding ten million rupees taxed?
answer: As a final tax at the rates in the proviso to clause (2) of Division I Part I First Schedule; individuals aged 70 or more are not taxed on pension

question: My father still works for the company that pays his pension. How is his pension taxed?
answer: Same as salary under section 149 (normal slab rates)

question: I got a dividend on shares of a power producer (IPP). How much tax is cut if I'm a filer?
I receive dividend from ordinary listed company shares. What rate is deducted, and what if I don't file returns?
I hold units of a mutual fund that invests in both debt and shares. How is the dividend taxed?
answer: 25% on the debt-securities part and 15% on the equities part for ATL (50% and 30% for non-ATL)

question: Per Circular 01 of 2025-26, how is a dividend from a mutual fund taxed where the recipient is a company and the distribution is out of profit on debt?
answer: At the corporate rate in Division II of Part I of the First Schedule instead of 25%

question: What is the withholding rate on dividends from mutual funds deriving fifty percent or more income from profit on debt?
What rate applies to a dividend received by a REIT scheme from a Special Purpose Vehicle?
What is the rate on dividend received by others from a Special Purpose Vehicle under the REIT Regulations, 2015?
The company whose shares I own pays no tax because of old business losses. Does that change the tax on my dividend?
How much tax does the bank cut from the profit on my savings account if I'm a filer?
What is the rate on yield on Government securities under clause (c) of section 151(1) paid to any person other than an individual?
Did the 2025 budget change the tax on profit from National Savings or Post Office savings accounts?
answer: No, it remains unchanged (bank deposits and government securities went from 15% to 20%)

question: What is the rate on yield or profit in cases other than clauses (a) and (b) of Division-IA, Part-III of the First Schedule?
What non-filer rate on profit on debt was specified in the Tenth Schedule before Finance Act 2025, and what applies from tax year 2026?
answer: Previously 35%; from tax year 2026 a hundred percent increase in the rate applies for non-filers

question: What is the rate on profit on sukuk paid under sub-section (1A) when the sukuk-holder is a company?
I invested in Islamic bonds (sukuk) and my return is over 10 lakh a year. What rate applies to me as an individual?
I have a small sukuk investment and earn under 10 lakh a year from it. What rate is deducted from my profit?
I sold government debt securities through my bank's counter and made a gain. Will the bank deduct tax?
answer: Yes, 15% of the gross capital gain for ATL, 30% for non-ATL

question: Under section 151A, who collects advance tax on gains from disposal of debt securities and at what rate?
answer: Custodians of debt securities including banks holding IPS accounts, at 15%

question: What is the withholding rate under section 152 sub-section (1) on payments to non-residents?
What rate applies under section 152 sub-section (1A)?
What is the rate under section 152(1BA)?
I'm a foreign investor with no office in Pakistan and bought federal government bonds through an SCRA account. If I sell after four months, what tax applies on the gain?
answer: 20% for disposal within six months; 10% if held more than six months (per Circular 01)

question: What is the section 152(2A)(a) rate for a company?
What is the section 152(2A)(a) rate for persons other than a company?
A foreign software firm's Pakistan office does IT work for us. What tax do we deduct from their bill?
Under section 152(2A)(b), what is the rate for rendering services other than IT services and IT enabled services?
A foreign cricket player's Pakistani branch signs an event contract with us. What tax do we withhold?
answer: 15% of gross amount for ATL, 30% for non-ATL

question: What is the section 152(2A)(c) rate on execution of a contract for persons other than sports persons?
answer: 8% of gross amount for ATL, 16% for non-ATL

question: What rate applies under section 152 sub-section (1C)?
I run a consultancy company and a big client withholds tax on my fees. It was 9% before. What is it now?
Per Circular 01 of 2025-26, to what rate was withholding on specified services under section 153 increased, and what happens to IT services?
answer: Increased from 4% to 6%; IT and IT enabled services stay at 4%

question: I'm a sole trader supplying stationery to a company and they deduct tax from my invoices. What rate as a filer?
My private limited company sells goods to a government department. What tax do they deduct if we're filers?
What is the section 153(1)(a) rate for companies in cases of toll manufacturing?
What is the section 153(1)(a) rate in cases other than companies, for toll manufacturing?
We supply rice to a big buyer. How much income tax do they hold back from our payment?
I'm a freelance software developer invoicing a local company. What should they deduct from my payment?
What is the rate under section 153(1)(b) in case of certain services?
My consulting work isn't in the special list of services. What does my client deduct from my bills?
answer: 15% of gross amount for ATL, 30% for non-ATL

question: We pay a TV channel and a newspaper for our ads. How much tax do we deduct from them?
answer: 1.5% of gross amount for ATL, 3% for non-ATL

question: I'm a professional cricketer paid by a franchise under a contract. What rate is withheld?
What is the rate under section 153(1)(c) on contracts executed by a company?
I'm a building contractor working in my own name, not as a company. What tax is cut from my contract payments?
We do stitching work for an exporter. What does the exporter deduct from our payments?
What is the section 153(2A) rate on digitally ordered goods paid through digital means or banking channels by a payment intermediary?
answer: 1% of gross amount for ATL, 2% for non-ATL

question: I sell clothes through my Instagram page and customers pay cash to the courier on delivery. How much tax does the courier keep?
answer: 2% of gross amount for ATL, 4% for non-ATL

question: Per Circular 01 of 2025-26, who is the payment intermediary when a vendor sells through an online market place and payment is made online?
answer: The bank or financial institution of the OMP in the second and final arm settling payment between vendor and buyer

question: My online store takes card payments through the website. Who is responsible for collecting the tax on my sales?
Is tax collected under section 153(2A) on e-commerce transactions a final tax?
answer: Yes, final tax under section 6A on income from local e-commerce; withholding under 154 and 154A falls outside the regime

question: How does clause (19AA) of section 2 define e-commerce?
answer: Sale or purchase of goods and services over computer networks by methods designed for receiving or placing orders through websites, mobile apps or online marketplace

question: What is a payment intermediary as defined for section 153?
answer: A third party entity (bank, FI, licensed exchange company or payment gateway) that facilitates transfer of funds between parties without being the ultimate source or recipient

question: How does clause (38B) of section 2 define an online marketplace?
answer: An IT platform run by an e-commerce entity over an electronic network acting as facilitator between buyer and seller

question: I export textiles. What tax is taken from my export proceeds?
I'm registered with PSEB and export software services to clients abroad. What rate is deducted from my foreign payments?
answer: 0.25% for ATL, 0.5% for non-ATL (tax years 2024 to 2026)

question: What is the section 154A rate on export of services in any other case?
What is the rate under section 154 sub-sections (3), (3A), (3B) and (3C)?
I rent out my house for Rs 25,000 a month, so 3 lakh a year. Will the tenant deduct any tax?
My shop's rent is 5 lakh a year and the tenant is a company. How much should they deduct from me as an individual landlord?
answer: 5% of the gross amount exceeding Rs. 300,000

question: I get Rs 12 lakh a year rent for my flat from a company tenant. How much tax should they deduct from me?
answer: Rs. 15,000 plus 10% of the gross amount exceeding Rs. 600,000

question: A bank pays me 30 lakh a year rent for a branch in my building. How much tax do they deduct?
answer: Rs. 155,000 plus 25% of the gross amount exceeding Rs. 2,000,000

question: What is the section 155 withholding rate on rent paid to a company?
Can I use losses from my shop business to reduce tax on the rent I earn from another property?
answer: No, Finance Act 2025 disallows setting off business losses against income from property

question: I won a prize bond draw. How much tax gets deducted?
I won a car in a company's lucky draw on shopping. What tax applies?
I run a petrol pump. How much tax is taken on my sales of petrol?
I'm not registered with FBR. How much tax does the bank cut when I take out cash?
Under section 231AB, above what daily amount is advance tax on cash withdrawal deducted?
answer: Aggregate cash withdrawals exceeding Rs. 50,000 in a day

question: Did the budget change what the bank takes when a non-filer withdraws cash?
Under the Fifteenth Schedule, what is the annual cash withdrawal limit for an ineligible person under section 114C(1)(d)?
answer: Rs. 100 million in all bank accounts held by an individual

question: I'm selling a plot for Rs 3 crore and I'm a filer. How much advance tax at transfer?
I don't file returns and I'm selling a house for Rs 8 crore. What advance tax do I pay?
What is the late filer rate under section 236C where the gross consideration exceeds Rs. 100 million?
I'm buying an apartment for Rs 2 crore and I'm on the filer list. How much advance tax do I pay as the buyer?
I haven't filed returns and want to buy a Rs 7 crore property. What advance tax do I pay?
What is the section 236K rate for a late filer where fair market value exceeds Rs. 100 million?
I filed my return late this year and I'm buying a house for Rs 4 crore. What advance tax do I pay?
answer: 4.5% (late filer rate, value up to Rs. 50 million)

question: How did Finance Act 2025 change advance tax rates under sections 236C and 236K?
answer: Buyer (236K) rates reduced by 1.5% per slab; seller (236C) rates increased by 1.5% per slab

question: I've lived in my house for 20 years and it's in my wealth statement. When I sell it, can I avoid the advance tax?
answer: Yes, can apply for an exemption certificate under section 159 if used personally and declared for last 15 years and shown as residence; once every 15 years

question: I'm an overseas Pakistani with a NICOP and bought a flat using money from my foreign currency account. When I sell it, is the advance tax my final tax?
answer: Yes, it is final discharge of tax liability in lieu of capital gains tax under section 37

question: Under section 114C read with the Fifteenth Schedule, what is the transaction value specification for immovable property transfers by ineligible persons?
answer: Fair market value exceeding Rs. 100 million

question: I'm not a return filer. Can I book a new car worth 80 lakh under the new rules?
answer: No, an ineligible person is barred from buying a vehicle with invoice value above Rs. 7 million (once notified)

question: Under section 114C, what does sufficient resources mean?
answer: 130% of cash and cash equivalent assets declared

question: Can my parents' declared money count so that I'm allowed to buy property under the new eligibility rule?
answer: Yes, an eligible individual includes immediate family members: parents, spouse and dependent children

question: I'm buying a new 1000cc car and I'm a filer. What advance tax do I pay at registration?
I don't file returns and I'm registering a new 1300cc car. What's the advance tax?
I'm buying a brand new 1600cc SUV and I'm a filer. How much tax at registration?
I'm importing a 2800cc Land Cruiser and I'm a filer. What's the advance tax at registration?
What is the non-ATL rate under section 231B(1) for vehicles above 3000cc?
I'm buying a used 1300cc car, so ownership is being transferred to me. I'm a filer. What tax do I pay?
What is the section 231B(2) amount for 1801cc to 2000cc vehicles for non-ATL persons?
What amount is collected under section 231B(2A) for vehicles of 1,001cc to 2,000cc?
answer: Rs. 200,000 for ATL, Rs. 600,000 for non-ATL

question: Under section 231B(1), what rate applies where engine capacity is not applicable and the vehicle value is Rs. 5 million or more?
answer: 3% of the import value (or invoice value for local vehicles)

question: I'm buying a second-hand car. Does the transfer tax go down as the car gets older?
answer: Yes, reduced by 10% each year from the date of first registration

question: I'm not a filer and I'm taking a car on bank lease (ijara). Is there extra tax on it?
answer: Yes, 4% of the value of the vehicle

question: Under the proviso to section 231B(1), after how long is no advance tax collected?
answer: After five years from the date of first registration

question: I own a 1300cc car and I'm a filer. How much yearly advance tax is added with my token tax?
Under section 234, what is the amount for motor vehicles up to 1000cc where motor vehicle tax is collected in lump sum?
answer: Rs. 10,000 for ATL, Rs. 20,000 for non-ATL

question: What is the section 234 rate per seat for passenger transport vehicles with 20 persons or more?
answer: Rs. 1,000 for ATL, Rs. 1,500 for non-ATL

question: I run a goods truck. What yearly advance tax do I pay?
answer: Rs. 2.50 per kg of laden weight (Rs. 1,200 per annum above 8,120 kg)

question: I don't file returns and have a 2400cc car. What yearly advance tax comes with my token tax?
We're hiring a Filipino nanny. Is there any tax when getting her visa?
answer: Rs. 200,000 for ATL, Rs. 400,000 for non-ATL

question: My shop's electricity bill is Rs 15,000 a month. How much income tax is in it?
Our factory's electricity bill is Rs 3 lakh a month. What income tax is charged?
answer: Rs. 1,950 plus 5% of amount exceeding Rs. 20,000 (industrial); 12% for commercial

question: I don't file returns and my home electricity bill is Rs 30,000 a month. Is any income tax added?
My home landline bill is Rs 3,000 a month. How much tax is charged?
answer: 10% of the bill amount exceeding Rs. 1,000

question: How much tax is included when I load credit on my prepaid mobile or buy an internet package?
answer: 15% of the bill or sale price

question: I run an ad agency and earn commission from TV channels. What rate is deducted?
I sell life insurance and my commission is under 5 lakh a year. What rate is taken?
I work as a commission agent for a company, not in advertising or insurance. What's deducted from my commission?
We're a fertilizer distributor and a filer. What advance tax does the manufacturer collect from us?
What is the non-ATL rate under section 236G on sales to distributors, dealers and wholesalers other than fertilizers?
I own a retail shop and I don't file returns. The wholesaler adds tax on my purchases. How much?
I bought a car at a government auction. What tax applies?
answer: 10% of gross sale price for ATL, 20% for non-ATL

question: What advance tax is added to a wedding hall bill?
I pay for Netflix and online shopping abroad with my debit card. Is there any tax?
A company I hold shares in gave me free extra shares. Is any tax withheld on them?
Our TV channel wants to air a Turkish drama serial. How much advance tax do we pay per episode?
I'm a full-time university lecturer. Is there any tax cut for teachers now?
answer: Yes, 25% rebate on tax payable, reintroduced for three tax years, not available from tax year 2026

question: Under clause (3A) of Part III of the Second Schedule, by how much is tax on a full-time teacher's salary reduced, and who is excluded?
answer: Reduced by 25% of tax payable on salary; excludes medical teachers with private practice income

question: I spent 190 days in Pakistan this year and the rest in Dubai. Am I a tax resident?
answer: Yes, resident if present 183 days or more in the tax year

question: Under section 24, what useful life is used for an intangible with no ascertainable useful life?
My company paid minimum turnover tax above its actual tax. For how many years can we carry the extra forward?
I buy from suppliers who don't have NTNs. Can I still claim the full expense?
answer: No, 10% of the expenditure attributable to such purchases is disallowed

question: What is disallowed under clause (s) of section 21?
answer: 50% of expenditure for sales where payment over Rs. 200,000 against a single invoice is received otherwise than through banking channel or digital means

question: My customer deposits cash straight into my company's bank account for a 5 lakh invoice. Will part of my expenses be disallowed?
answer: No, it is treated as payment through banking channel, so no disallowance

question: Which recreational clubs are excluded from the definition of non-profit organization in clause (36) of section 2?
answer: Clubs whose joining fee for any class of new members exceeds one million rupees

question: Until when is the income exemption for Special Economic Zones available after Finance Act 2025?
answer: Up to tax year 2035 or ten years from commencement of commercial operations, whichever is earlier

question: I'm opening a cinema in Lahore next year. Will its income be tax-free?
answer: Exempt for five years from commencement or till 30 June 2030, whichever is earlier

question: What period does the exemption under clause (145A) of Part I of the Second Schedule cover for the Tribal Area?
Under the redrafted clause (105A), when is a person immune from selection for audit?
answer: If selected for audit in any of the preceding three tax years

question: I lost my case at the tax tribunal. How long do I have to appeal to the High Court?
answer: Within sixty days of receiving the ATIR judgement, on questions of law only

question: We bought machinery but didn't deduct withholding tax when paying the supplier. Can we still claim depreciation on it?
answer: No, depreciation is inadmissible and the amount is not part of the asset's cost
